descriptionMarkdown:
A space fleet for grinding all legendary resources from space. This ships are designed to be as cheap as possible and uses the minimum possible number of quality buildings, so that entire fleet of these ships can be easily built

The blueprint book currently contains five ship versions.
1. UNIVERSAL COMMON. The spaceship is completely common quality. Suitable for the very beginning of resource grinding, and may be updated in the future for better quality and performance. Produces all types of resources at once
2. UNIVERSAL LEGENDARY. A similar ship, but with semi-legendary quality
3. Specialized ships for the extraction of one type of resource

(The "ANANKE" series of ships are now the core design, and other configurations are based on them. The Titan is an outdated but still stable design.)

Ships produce the following amount of resources:
1. Iron. 11,000 iron plates per minute, also produces iron ore.
2. Coal. 700 coal per minute, additional sulfur and carbon production.
3. Ice and calcite production, 600 and 400 per minute, respectively.

How to use

Build a ship. Use a group of requests for a quick start and send about 4k magazines for the fastest possible start. After literally a couple of minutes, the ship is ready for use and send it on a flight between the inner planets to collect resources, when the conveyor is filled with missiles, the ship is completely ready. That’s it, in most cases nothing else is required of you, but there are a couple of additional settings

The constant combinator, which is located just below the main hub, is responsible for the amount of resources that will accumulate in the storages, you can change it at your discretion. There is a smart interrupt set up here, the most important thing is that your value does not overflow the ship's main hub, otherwise it will not return on its own and you will have to manually set up the interrupt.

Other useful information
1. The number of resources produced is indicated taking into account the research of asteroid crushing technology productivity at 100%, accordingly, if your research is higher, then the productivity will increase
2. The ship's defense is created with a huge reserve, for adequate functioning you do not need weapons damage technologies at all, if you have upgraded defense at least to level 10, then you can remove the second row of missile turrets to make the ship cheaper
3. The ship uses a smart, timer refueling system using combinators. The ship can operate continuously for 30 hours on a single refueling cycle, reducing the need for refueling and resulting in greater productivity.
4. More ship versions will be added in the future, it will be even more interesting soon.

I will be very glad for your like support, you can also check other blueprints in my profile
title: Legendary asteroid collector fleet. Asteroid upcycler
